jobs.description:
Sales Engineer (SE)Help Make Manufacturing the Most Secure Industry in the World

At Secomea, we are on a mission to make manufacturing the most secure industry in the world.

We are looking for a customer-focused Sales Engineer who can bridge the gap between complex technical environments and commercial success. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales and customers throughout the buying journey, helping prospects understand, validate, and successfully adopt Secomea's solutions.

You will play a critical role in technical discovery, solution design, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and technical deal execution, ensuring customers have the confidence to choose Secomea as their trusted cybersecurity partner.

This is a highly customer-facing role where you will work closely with Sales, Implementation, Product, and technical teams to understand customer challenges, design the right technical solution, and help customers validate that Secomea is the right choice for their environment.

You will report to Jesper Sønderby Andersen, Senior Director of Global CSM, Professional and Implementation Services, Solution Architects.

About Secomea

Secomea is on a mission to make manufacturing the most secure industry in the world.

Trusted by thousands of industrial companies worldwide, we provide secure remote access and cybersecurity solutions that help manufacturers, machine builders, and infrastructure operators connect, monitor, and support critical equipment safely and efficiently.

Headquartered in Denmark and operating globally, Secomea combines deep industrial expertise with a strong cybersecurity focus. We are ambitious, customer-centric, and passionate about solving complex challenges for some of the world's most important industries.

Joining Secomea means becoming part of a growing international company where your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your work has a direct impact on customers around the globe.

Your Mission

As one of our Sales Engineers, your primary objective is to establish Secomea as the preferred technical solution and remove technical barriers throughout the sales process.

You will partner with Sales from opportunity qualification through discovery, solution design, technical validation, Proof of Concept execution, and deal closure.

A significant part of your role will involve leading and executing customer PoCs. You will define success criteria, design and configure solutions, coordinate technical evaluations, solve challenges, and ensure customers reach a clear and confident technical decision.

Your role is not simply to demonstrate technology. You will help customers understand how Secomea solves their specific challenges and deliver the confidence needed to move forward.

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Discovery & Solution Design

• 
Support Sales in qualifying opportunities and determining the appropriate level of technical engagement.

• 
Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, challenges, security requirements, and success criteria.

• 
Design secure and scalable solution architectures aligned with customer OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity environments.

• 
Identify technical risks early and develop mitigation strategies.

• 
Deliver tailored demonstrations that address each customer's unique needs and use cases.

• 
Translate technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes and customer value.

Proof of Concept (PoC) Leadership

A key part of this role is planning and executing successful customer PoCs.

You will:

• 
Define scope, success criteria, timelines, responsibilities, and decision points.

• 
Configure and deploy Secomea solutions within customer environments.

• 
Collaborate directly with OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity teams.

• 
Ensure agreed use cases and success criteria are validated.

• 
Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate with Product, Support, R&D, and Implementation teams when required.

• 
Maintain momentum and proactively manage technical blockers and dependencies.

• 
Present findings and technical recommendations to customer stakeholders.

• 
Support Sales in converting successful technical validation into commercial success.

• 
Capture learnings and continuously improve technical playbooks, demonstrations, and future engagements.

Technical Deal Execution

• 
Own the technical solution strategy for assigned opportunities.

• 
Support RFIs and RFPs with clear and compelling technical responses.

• 
Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, and implementation recommendations.

• 
Support security reviews, technical due diligence, and customer audits.

• 
Address technical objections throughout the sales process.

• 
Position Secomea effectively against competing solutions.

• 
Build trusted relationships with customer technical teams and decision-makers.

• 
Ensure technical decision criteria are met and no unresolved blockers remain before deal closure.

Continuous Improvement

At Secomea, winning deals is important, but learning from them is equally valuable.

You will:

• 
Conduct win/loss reviews on relevant opportunities.

• 
Identify recurring objections, competitive challenges, and market trends.

• 
Maintain accurate technical opportunity data within Salesforce.

• 
Share customer and market insights with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams.

• 
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Sales Engineering processes, demonstrations, and technical positioning.

What You'll Need to Succeed

To succeed in this role, you will be able to:

• 
Understand complex technical environments across OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity.

• 
Translate customer requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.

• 
Lead structured discovery sessions and uncover business and technical needs.

• 
Manage complex Proofs of Concept involving multiple stakeholders.

• 
Troubleshoot technical issues methodically and effectively.

• 
Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• 
Build credibility with engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and technical decision-makers.

• 
Balance technical expertise with commercial awareness.

• 
Take ownership and drive customer engagements forward.

Required Qualifications

• 
Professional experience within Sales Engineering, Operational Technology (OT), Cybersecurity, or a similar technical customer-facing role.

• 
Experience working with enterprise customers and complex B2B sales cycles.

• 
Strong understanding of networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or industrial environments.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English and either French or German.

• 
Ability to confidently conduct customer meetings, workshops, technical discussions, and Proofs of Concept in English and either French or German.

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, customer success, and commercial impact.

You are curious, analytical, and customer-focused. You enjoy solving complex challenges, communicating clearly, and helping customers make informed technical decisions.

We imagine you bring experience from one or more of the following areas:

• 
Sales Engineering / Pre-Sales

• 
Operational Technology (OT)

• 
Cybersecurity

Experience across multiple disciplines will be considered a significant advantage.

It Would Be a Strong Advantage If You Have

• 
Experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role.

• 
Experience planning and executing customer PoCs or technical pilots.

• 
Experience working with industrial customers, manufacturers, machine builders, or critical infrastructure.

• 
Strong presentation and demonstration skills.

• 
The ability to simplify complex technical concepts for different audiences.

• 
A strong customer-centric mindset and commercial understanding.

• 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Product, Support, and Implementation teams.

How We Think About Sales Engineering

At Secomea, Sales Engineering is not just about answering technical questions or delivering product demonstrations.

A great Sales Engineer helps move customers from:

Relevant → Secure → Validated → Justified → Closed

You help establish that:

• 
Secomea is relevant to the customer's challenges.

• 
The proposed architecture is secure and technically viable.

• 
The solution works within the customer's environment.

• 
Technical and business value are clearly understood.

• 
Risks and objections are proactively addressed.

• 
The customer is confident in selecting Secomea as their trusted partner.

Why Join Secomea

• 
Join a global cybersecurity company with ambitious growth plans.

• 
Work with some of the world's leading industrial companies and manufacturers.

• 
Influence strategic customer decisions and directly impact commercial success.

• 
Collaborate with talented colleagues across Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering.

• 
Be part of a culture built on trust, ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.

If you're passionate about cybersecurity, industrial technology, and helping customers solve real-world challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are committed to advancing sustainable and energy-efficient solutions that help our customers and communities thrive. As a Global Demand Planner (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring our business has a reliable, data-driven view of future customer demand, enabling informed decisions across the value chain.

You will serve as a critical link between our commercial organization and supply chain teams, transforming data, market insights, and stakeholder input into robust demand forecasts. Your work will directly influence inventory levels, production planning, capacity utilization, and customer satisfaction.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with business understanding. As part of our continued global growth, you will help shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and create alignment across functions, while leveraging data and technology to make a measurable impact on our customers and business performance.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and continuously improve demand forecasts for assigned products, markets, or business areas by combining data analysis with commercial and market insights.

• Lead the monthly demand planning process and drive alignment with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Planning, and other key stakeholders.

• Analyze demand trends, forecast performance, and market developments to identify risks, opportunities, and actions that support better business decisions.

• Translate customer developments, product launches, phase-outs, and other business changes into accurate and actionable demand plans.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Planning to align demand and supply while supporting inventory, service, and operational targets.

• Contribute to the enhancement of demand planning processes, tools, automation, and digital capabilities to strengthen forecasting effectiveness.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Educational background in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• Experience in demand planning, forecasting, S&OP, or a related supply chain discipline.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to transform data into meaningful business insights and recommendations.

• Experience working with Excel, ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, or related technologies; knowledge of IBP is an advantage.

• Good understanding of forecasting principles and demand drivers, combined with the ability to communicate insights, challenge assumptions, and influence stakeholders across functions.

• A structured, proactive, and self-driven approach, combined with strong collaboration skills and professional English communication abilities.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Head of Marketing - Nordics and UK
jobs.description:
**Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK

**

• Location: Gentofte, Copenhagen, Denmark

• Working hours: Full-time

• Work model: Hybrid

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

• Travel: Regular travel across our markets, particularly the Nordics and the UK

Are you passionate about turning brand and commercial strategy into activation that drives real impact with consumers? Do you want to be the critical link between Brand Marketing and Commercial teams across the Nordics and the UK? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK, you will be part of the Trade & Activation team and play an important role in translating brand and commercial strategies into impactful market activation plans that drive adult consumer engagement, strengthen brand equity and deliver commercial growth across the Nordic and UK markets. You will work closely with Brand Marketing and Commercial teams to ensure our brands come to life consistently and effectively across channels, customers and consumer touchpoints. Reporting to the Trade & Activation Director for Europe, you will lead and develop a team of 7 direct reports. This is a great opportunity to act as the critical link between brand strategy and commercial execution in an international organization.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Own the activation agenda for our Nordic and UK markets, translating brand and commercial priorities and channel-specific strategies into impactful market programs.

• Develop and execute annual activation plans that drive adult consumer recruitment, engagement, retention and brand preference across the portfolio.

• Partner closely with Sales and Key Account teams to build customer activation plans that strengthen distribution, visibility, conversion and category growth.

• Translate consumer, shopper and market insights into activation programs that create measurable commercial impact.

• Manage the development and deployment of activation toolkits, point-of-sale materials and execution standards to ensure consistent market execution.

• Monitor activation performance, evaluate ROI and continuously optimize investment allocation, contributing to annual commercial planning.

**What You'll Bring

**

• Significant experience in Brand Activation, Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, Consumer Engagement or Commercial Marketing, ideally within tobacco, nicotine, FMCG, beverages or other regulated consumer goods industries.

• A proven track record of developing and executing activation programs that deliver measurable commercial results, with a strong understanding of consumer behavior, shopper dynamics and route-to-market strategies.

• A commercially driven mindset, with experience managing activation budgets and optimizing resource allocation across multiple markets to connect investment to business performance and ROI.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Insights and external agency partners, operating effectively within matrix organizations.

• A proactive, growth-oriented attitude with a passion for excellence in execution and continuous improvement.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English and a Nordic language.

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

• Recruiter screen

• Interview with the hiring team

• Assessment, case study, or work sample, if relevant

• Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

_Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

_

jobs.occupation: Personal Assistant to the Sales Director
jobs.description:
Are you naturally organised, commercially curious and motivated by working close to business decisions? Do you enjoy connecting people, keeping things moving and making sure the details are in place?

Then this could be your opportunity to take on a central role in SELECTED's international sales organisation.

YOUR TEAM

You will become part of SELECTED's international wholesale organisation, working closely with the Sales Director and Sales Management Team. From this central position, you will collaborate with colleagues across departments and markets, helping connect people, priorities and business initiatives.

You will also work closely with the PA network across SELECTED and take part in the strategic steering group, giving you insight into the decisions and priorities shaping our sales organisation.

YOUR ROLE

As Personal Assistant to our Sales Director, you will combine business support, coordination and project-related responsibilities with the day-to-day tasks that keep a busy sales organisation running smoothly. You will work closely with the Sales Director as a trusted sparring partner, contributing your own perspectives, asking questions and challenging ideas when you see opportunities to do things differently.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating and following up on projects and strategic initiatives across the Wholesale organisation.

• Preparing presentations, business updates and management materials that support discussions and decisions.

• Supporting business reporting, KPI follow-up and the preparation of relevant insights.

• Working with colleagues across departments and markets to ensure clear communication and progress on agreed actions.

• Managing day-to-day PA responsibilities, including meeting preparation, minutes, scheduling and practical coordination.

• Improving processes and exploring how AI and digital tools can simplify administrative tasks and ways of working.

YOUR BENEFITS

At SELECTED, you'll have the opportunity to get close to the business and build valuable experience in an international sales organisation. You can look forward to:

• Working directly with the Sales Director and getting involved in the priorities and initiatives shaping our commercial direction.

• Collaborating with colleagues across markets and departments, building relationships and gaining insight into different parts of the business.

• Taking ownership of your work, contributing your ideas and developing your skills through varied responsibilities.

YOUR PROFILE

You are curious about business, naturally outgoing and enjoy working with people across different teams and levels. You find it easy to build relationships and bring structure to a busy environment. You take initiative, speak up when you have a different perspective and are comfortable questioning decisions when something doesn't make sense. At the same time, you take pride in getting the practical details right and following through on your commitments.

Your background could be in business support, coordination or a related field, but previous experience as a Personal Assistant is not essential. What matters most is your willingness to take responsibility for both the administrative and business-related aspects of the role.

We also imagine that you:

• Have strong organisational skills and know how to prioritise when several things need your attention.

• Are comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.

• Are interested in AI, digital tools and using data to support better decisions.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish.

• Experience from the fashion industry would be an advantage, but not a requirement.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Pernille Dyrendom Thøgersen, Personal Assistant, on +45 30 85 33 58. Otherwise send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

ABOUT SELECTED

Based in Denmark, SELECTED is an international brand for men and women, providing modern consumers a unique offering of style and craftmanship at an attractive price point. We always strive to add an edgy touch to our progressive styles and aim to offer collections that can be the base to any wardrobe, always in sync with the current tendencies. We aim for quality over quantity, which is why sustainability is a main focus for us. Every collection should be more sustainable than the last. This underlines the responsibility we take for our future environmental footprint. With SELECTED you are never out of style but have a quality that is built to last. SELECTED is part of the worldwide fashion company BESTSELLER. For more information, please go to www.selected.com or www.bestseller.com. Based in Denmark, SELECTED is an international brand for men and women, providing modern consumers a unique offering of style and craftmanship at an attractive price point. At BESTSELLER, we own it. Every chance. Every challenge. Every choice. We’re the global fashion company that’s fast paced and family run. We’re the business that’s built some of the strongest brands in the industry. By empowering every individual to own their journey, we’ve found the courage to keep getting better. To act more sustainably. To foster diversity and provide equal opportunities. To compete more confidently. And to keep challenging the status quo. Time and time again. We are BESTSELLER - and together, we own it.

jobs.occupation: Analyst in Capital Planning – Help Shape the Bank’s Financial Future
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process.

More specifically, you will:

• Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections

• Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams

• Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers

• Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs

• Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables

**About You

**

• Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English

• Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field

• Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals

Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

A hands-on, mid-level role turning benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, supporting transfer to manufacturing partners and delivering material for formulation, soil and field testing.

About Yngvi Bio

At Yngvi Bio, we are building a biological crop-protection platform based on targeted, non-living protein complexes. Our technology combines AI-guided protein design, insect genetics and microbial production. We are moving active prototypes from biological testing into scalable fermentation, formulation, soil and field validation.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on, mid-level Bioprocessing Specialist to turn benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, support transfer to manufacturing partners and deliver consistent material for formulation, soil and field testing. This individual-contributor role suits someone who has directly participated in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles and still enjoys working at the bench and bioreactor.

Key responsibilities

• Fermentation development. Plan and execute microbial batch and fed-batch fermentations, including media, feed, induction, pH, dissolved oxygen, aeration, temperature and harvest strategies.

• Protein expression and optimization. Improve recombinant protein expression, solubility, yield, product quality and robustness by linking process conditions to biological performance.

• Scale-up and technology transfer. Translate laboratory processes toward 50-1,000 L and beyond; define scale criteria, run plans, acceptance criteria and transfer packages, and support partner execution.

• Production execution. Run repeatable, traceable batches that supply characterized material for formulation, soil, greenhouse and field testing.

• Harvest and fit-for-purpose recovery. Personally perform and improve harvest, cell disruption or extraction, clarification, concentration and the minimal purification needed for testing.

• Troubleshooting, data and quality control. Use structured experiments, data analysis, in-process controls and practical quality checks to investigate deviations and connect upstream choices to recovery and lot quality.

• Documentation and collaboration. Maintain SOPs, batch records, risk assessments and transfer documentation, and work closely with scientists, formulation and agronomy colleagues, quality functions and external manufacturing partners.

You will be responsible for practical process development and execution while helping Yngvi Bio build the documentation and production discipline needed for reliable internal batches and partner transfer.

Qualifications

• Relevant experience. Typically 3-6 years in microbial fermentation, upstream bioprocess development or production-facing biotechnology.

• Hands-on fermentation. Strong practical experience setting up, running, sampling and troubleshooting microbial bioreactors.

• Recombinant protein expression. Practical experience with microbial expression is important; bacterial systems such as E. coli are preferred. You can connect process conditions to expression, solubility, quality and recovery.

• Scale-up evidence. Direct involvement in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles beyond small laboratory reactors, with the ability to explain what changed between scales.

• Production and downstream practice. Experience producing test or pilot material and personally performing harvest, extraction, clarification and basic purification or recovery.

• Education and working style. BSc, MSc, PhD or equivalent practical expertise in engineering, biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related field, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach suited to an early-stage company.

• Valuable extras. Experience expressing virus-like particles, capsid-like structures, multimeric or self-assembling proteins, or other complex recombinant proteins is a bonus. Experience with design of experiments, automation, advanced downstream processing, CDMOs or agricultural biotechnology is also valuable.

What we offer

• A role with direct influence on how Yngvi Bio turns designed proteins into repeatable, scalable production.

• Work spanning fermentation, production, scale-up and the delivery of material for formulation, soil and field testing.

• A small international team at BioInnovation Institute where you can build practical systems, solve difficult technical challenges and grow with the role.

Role details

Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen. The role is laboratory-based and may involve occasional partner or manufacturing-site travel.

Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a short application describing your hands-on fermentation, recombinant-protein production and scale-up experience to info@yngvi.bio.

Application reference: Begin the subject line or application title with Yngvi-BP26-[Surname] Application. For example: Yngvi-BP26-Nielsen Application.

Job Description

**_Are you a recent graduate or in the early stages of your career, and would you like to turn data into useful knowledge? And would you like to work directly with clients while keeping up to date with new technologies within data engineering? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools.

_**

• Contract: Full-time

• Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

**This is a hands-on coding role focused on turning complex data challenges into production-ready solutions while talking with our clients to ensure we deliver according to their needs.

Specifically, you will:

• Build robust data pipelines and models that streamline the ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data.

• Implement and develop modern data platforms through DevOps & CI/CD practices.

• Collaborate with our clients’ engineers, analysts, & business users to solve business issues and ensure lasting value.

You will be guided by and learn from our many senior data engineers.

About You

**Ideally, you have:

• Either recently completed (or soon to complete) a Master’s degree in a relevant field or worked as a Data Engineer but still in the start of your career.

• Proficiency in either Python, PySpark, SQL, or APIs.

• It’s a plus if you have experience with Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, or AI technologies, but if you don’t have it, no worries - we will teach you!

• An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

• Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

• A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still highly encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

**You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with great colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

• Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our core technologies. We are sure you’ll thrive by being inspired and inspiring others across our global network of data experts.

• Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited self-paid time off when you want it.

• Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year with all sorts of fun activities outside of work. We have committees that plan sports, cultural and party events which you are more than welcome to participate in.

Our Impact

**Below are a few examples of our recent work:

• Migrated Novo’s global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using DBT, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

• Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

• Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service landscape to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

**Apply by uploading your CV and grades **no later than November 23rd.

**We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

**Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

**

Stillingsbeskrivelse

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

With a focus on the international defense industry, Sky-Watch A/S develops, manufactures, and implements high-tech solutions in the form of drone and sensor technology. Through cutting-edge UAS technology, battle-proven products, experienced instructors, skilled technicians, and dedicated support personnel, the company delivers the best M-UAS platform and associated UAV solutions. These solutions empower decision-makers in complex and high-risk environments worldwide to make safe and effective decisions—ultimately enhancing the overall success of their missions.

Sky-Watch is dedicated to establishing relationships and ensuring visibility among key decision-makers in its target customer segments. This audience primarily consists of stakeholders at political, ministerial, general staff, and operational levels.

Founded in 2009, Sky-Watch is headquartered in Støvring and currently employs +145 people. The company culture is driven by passionate and highly skilled employees motivated by the ambition to develop technology of the highest quality, as well as a curiosity that ensures continuous product innovation and value creation.

To strengthen the Product Marketing Team, Sky-Watch is now looking for a highly skilled and driven

Product Marketing Manager

1st class product – Go-to-Market – Sales Enablement

Do you want to play a key role in shaping how a fast-growing international defence company positions, communicates and brings its products to market? As the new Product Marketing Manager at Sky-Watch you will take ownership of product and portfolio messaging, use cases, and go-to-market execution across the entire platform, ensuring clarity, credibility, and impact throughout a high-consideration B2G/defence buying process. You will join a high-tech company with market-leading UAV technology, operating in a rapidly growing and strategically important defence sector, where innovation, proactivity, and technical excellence are deeply embedded in the culture.

You will report directly to the Director of Product Marketing, and your key responsibilities will include:

• Positioning & Messaging: Own product and portfolio positioning, value propositions, and messaging frameworks across channels.

• Use Cases & Stories: Own use cases and case stories, ensuring they are reused across marketing, sales, and partner activities.

• Go-to-Market & Launches: Lead product launches, major updates, and software releases, including narratives, release communication, and enablement materials.

• Sales & Partner Enablement: Develop and maintain sales and partner enablement assets, supporting effective pitching and objection handling.

• Market & Competitive Insight: Translate customer, market, and competitor insights into clear messaging and go-to-market priorities.

• Trust & Compliance Content: Ensure procurement-facing and compliance-related content supports the buying journey clearly and consistently.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Align Product, Marketing, Sales, and partners by translating roadmap decisions into market-ready communication.

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing/Communication, Technology Management, or a related field combining commercial and technical focus. You bring at least five years of experience in B2B or B2G product or solution marketing, preferably from technology-driven, regulated, or complex industries such as defence, aerospace, or B2B SaaS. You have proven experience defining positioning and value propositions, developing go-to-market plans, and creating practical sales enablement materials in close collaboration with product management, engineering or software teams, as well as sales and channel partners. You are skilled at translating complex technical products into clear customer value and compelling narratives and are fluent in professional English.

You reside within an hour drive from the office in Støving, and you must be willing to travel approximately 30-40 days a year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. Furthermore, you are proactive and structured, and you are able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You thrive in a fast-changing environment and manage to keep calm and handle multiple products, projects and deadlines in parallel. With a strong analytical and curious mind-set, you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable plans and translate complex topics into compelling, easy-to-understand communication. Finally, you are highly collaborative and relationship-oriented, able to build trust and alignment across multiple stakeholders, while also working independently when needed.

Are you the new Product Marketing Manager at Sky-Watch in Støvring? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant from Sensu A/S, Martin Tveit, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky-Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com

jobs.occupation: Defence Business Development Lead, Space Inventor
jobs.description:
Space Inventor is looking for an experienced Defence Business Development Lead to drive business development, collaboration and sales within the defence and security market.

The Defence Business Development Lead will be responsible for identifying, developing and closing opportunities with defence customers, government organisations, procurement agencies, defence primes and strategic industry partners across Europe and internationally, with a focus on European, Nordic and Baltic regions.

The role will focus on satellite missions, constellations and space-based capabilities supporting areas such as ISR, SIGINT, Earth observation, maritime surveillance, situational awareness, secure communications and sovereign space capabilities.

This is a senior hands-on government- and customer-facing role. You will own opportunities from early market engagement and requirement shaping through RFI/RFP, proposal development, negotiation and contract award. As the business development lead, you will be supported by a cross-functional team of specialists that will help shape competitive and technically sound proposals.

A key part of the role is to engage with partners/primes and government officials before formal procurements are released. You will use your existing defence network and market understanding to identify emerging requirements, programmes and partnerships where Space Inventor's satellite capabilities can create operational value.

You do not need to be a satellite engineer, but you must have a solid understanding of the sales cycle and the ability to navigate complex sales processes. Additionally, you must be able to understand complex operational requirements and engage credibly with military, governmental, commercial and technical stakeholders.

The job is located in Aalborg or Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll report to the Mission Sales Director and work closely with both the marketing and sales teams.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead commercial negotiations covering scope, pricing, contractual conditions and programme requirements.

• Develop and grow Space Inventor's business within the European and international defence and security market, with focus on Nordics and Baltics.

• Identify and develop opportunities through an established network across Ministries of Defence, armed forces, procurement agencies, defence primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• Engage customers early to understand operational requirements, upcoming programmes and procurement plans before formal tenders are released.

• Own the commercial sales cycle from qualification through RFI/RFQ/RFP, proposal, negotiation and contract award.

• Develop strategic accounts and capture plans for priority defence programmes and customers.

• Identify and qualify local partners in the focus countries and build partnerships/consortia to address local needs and requirements.

• Monitor defence programmes, budgets, tenders, competitors and market developments to identify future opportunities.

• Maintain the defence sales pipeline, forecasts and opportunity strategies and contribute to Space Inventor's overall defence market strategy.

• Represent Space Inventor at customer meetings, exhibitions and industry events.

Qualifications

You should have strong knowledge of the defence sector, its operational environment and customer landscape, combined with a good understanding of space-based defence capabilities and their role in modern defence operations.

You do not need to be a technical space specialist, but you should be able to understand defence requirements, identify where satellite-based solutions can provide operational value and engage credibly with defence customers and Space Inventor's technical specialists.

We expect you to have:

• Significant proven experience within defence sales, business development, capture management, partnership development and complex defence solution sales.

• A successful track record of developing business with defence and governmental customers, including signed contracts and long-term strategic partnerships

• A strong and relevant existing network within the European defence industry, including relationships with defence organisations, procurement agencies, primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• A strong international outlook and preferably an established global defence network.

• Experience engaging directly with Ministries of Defence, armed forces, defence procurement organisations or other governmental stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of B2G sales and defence procurement processes.

• Ability to understand technically complex products and communicate their operational and commercial value.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Willingness to travel frequently within Europe and internationally.

• Ability to work closely with engineers and technical specialists when developing customer solutions.

Advantageous experience:

• Previous experience within space, satellites, ISR, SIGINT, electronic warfare, surveillance, secure communications, sensors, UAVs or other advanced defence technologies.

• Previous employment with a defence prime, defence technology company, military organisation, government organisation or procurement authority.

• Experience working with NATO nations or NATO organisations.

• Knowledge of European defence initiatives, funding programmes and procurement mechanisms.

• Military or governmental defence experience.

• Experience working with classified or security-sensitive programmes.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

About the role

Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations across all parts of the Information Communication Technology (ICT) organisation? If so, this may be the right opportunity for you. You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. The team oversees compliance risks across ICT, operational risk and data governance, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies. Working closely with Compliance colleagues in Denmark and internationally, you will play a key role in strengthening compliance oversight across Saxo's technology organisation. Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across ICT areas regulated by DORA, including ICT risk management, incident management, business continuity and resilience testing, access management, critical functions and systems and third-party ICT service providers. Depending on your profile, knowledge and experience, the role may also include compliance activities within operational risk, data quality and data governance. As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities

You will join an organisation where the foundation of the business is built on ICT and where platform availability is key to help clients get invested in the world. In the Prudential Oversight Compliance Team, ICT regulation is a core focus, and you will help us support Saxo in continuously driving this important area in a compliant direction. Your main responsibilities will be to:

• Perform compliance risk assessments within the areas of ICT risks, operational risks and data risks, with a particular focus on DORA-related requirements

• Provide advice, challenge and compliance opinions to the business on regulatory requirements and compliance risks

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities, including follow-up and closure of recommendations

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to the senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing Saxo’s compliance framework

• Collaborate closely with our Compliance Team in India

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

Your profile

We are looking for a colleague with solid experience working in ICT compliance, operational risk, data governance or technology risk management. Most importantly, you have experience working with ICT requirements and legislation, ICT governance, risk assessments, and advisory work related to ICT requirements, and you are familiar with DORA or NIS2. You may have gained this experience within a second line of defence compliance or risk function, a first line of defence risk or control role within financial services, internal or external audit, IT audit, consultancy or another highly regulated industry. Experience with operational risk and data governance is considered an advantage. Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork, and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation. It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’. You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on. You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success. We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations. When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense. At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply

: Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

About Saxo Bank

Support our purpose

We believe access to global capital markets is not only for the privileged few. Our vision is to enable people to fulfill their financial aspirations to make an impact. That’s why we use the power of technology to deliver clients what they need, when they need it in a user-friendly and personalised experience. We aim to deliver the world’s most user-friendly and personalized trading and investment platform experience, which gives our clients exactly what they need to make more informed investment decisions.

Be part of a unique journey

Do you want to work for an extremely ambitious organisation at the cutting edge of banking and technology? You’ll be joining a company that:

. Continuously strives to improve the Saxo Experience and exceed our clients’ expectations.

. Always invests in the future

. Builds unrivalled platforms for seasoned and experienced investors and wholesale clients that provide real-time access to global capital markets.

. Consistently wins the highest accolades for our platforms, products and services.

Own your future

So, if you’re up for the challenge of breaking down barriers in global financial markets, we’re always looking for ambitious and enthusiastic people who share our passion for clients, technology and innovation and can bring new perspectives to our diverse team. For more on our story, culture and identity, please read the Saxo Bank Foundation, written by our CEO and founder Kim Fournais.

Technical Sales Manager, Industrial Solutions, Denmark & Southern Sweden

• Are you a self-driven, ambitious sales professional who is always looking for new business opportunities and ways to make a difference for your customers?

• Do you want to become part of our Nordic Industrial Solutions team, where technical expertise, entrepreneurship, and close customer partnerships are at the heart of everything we do?

If so, this position at Alsiano might be the perfect match for you!

About Alsiano

For more than 65 years, Alsiano has partnered with leading international manufacturers of raw materials and additives. We specialize in raw materials and additives for industrial applications such as plastics and elastomers, paints and coatings, industrial and institutional (I&I) cleaning products, household cleaning products, food, and healthcare.

The Role

You will be responsible for your customer portfolio in Denmark and Southern Sweden, where you will offer plastic raw materials and additives. Your focus will be on growing your existing customer base while identifying new customers and business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct customer visits to identify potential and explore new business opportunities, prepare offers, negotiate prices, and follow up on projects and sales pipelines.

• Deliver technical product presentations and solution recommendations during customer meetings.

• Participate in relevant webinars, exhibitions, seminars, and other customer-related events.

• Proactively plan and manage your sales activities in a structured manner.

• Collaborate closely with key suppliers and identify opportunities for new supplier partnerships by recognizing market trends and customer needs.

You will independently drive the entire sales process, from building and managing your pipeline to arranging meetings and preparing offers. A significant portion of your time will involve customer visits and communication via webinars, phone, and other channels.

You will analyze customer needs, objectives, challenges, and opportunities, advising customers on how Alsiano's solutions can positively impact their products and business. In close collaboration with suppliers and colleagues, you will develop tailored solutions and successfully convert opportunities into sales.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have at least 3-5 years’ experience in technical B2B sales, combined with a relevant technical education. It is essential that you can effectively engage with customers, work independently, and bring a high level of energy and self-motivation.

You possess excellent negotiation and communication skills in Danish and English and have a good understanding of Swedish. Experience selling plastic raw materials to industrial customers is a distinct advantage.

Furthermore, you are:

• An ambitious and professional trusted advisor who delivers a high level of customer service.

• Able to balance both short-term and long-term objectives and prioritize your efforts accordingly.

• Results-oriented and motivated to achieve ambitious goals.

• Energetic, flexible, outgoing, and systematic in your approach.

• Quality-conscious with a strong attention to detail.

What We Offer

You will be part of a well-functioning Nordic Industrial Solutions team, where you work closely with colleagues across the Nordic region and report directly to the Head of Nordic Sales, Industrial Solutions, based in Gothenburg.

This is a challenging role in a collaborative and supportive environment, where we help each other grow, develop, and create value. We offer a flexible work environment, allowing you to work from Alsiano’s office in Birkerød or from home.

The position involves travel, primarily within Denmark and Southern Sweden, as well as occasional travel to other European countries, approximately 60-80 days per year.

jobs.occupation: Global Process Owner, Procure to Pay, ERP Transformation
jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Process Owner, Procure to Pay to be based in Ballerup, Denmark

In this role, you will own Ambu’s global end-to-end Procure to Pay process within our ERP transformation, from purchasing demand and supplier engagement through ordering, receipt, invoicing and payment. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with a functional reporting line to the VP Procurement & Facility, and work closely with Global Business Owners, other Global Process Owners, Finance, IT, Quality, sites and implementation partners.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a critical global process within a major transformation. It will suit an experienced procurement or P2P professional who combines strategic thinking with hands-on transformation delivery.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Owning the global P2P process design, standards, controls and performance

• Leading fit-to-standard process design with business experts, IT and our implementation partner

• Simplifying, standardizing and automating transactional flows to reduce manual work

• Driving stakeholder engagement, training, readiness and adoption across sites

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have experience across the Procure to Pay value stream and its interfaces to Finance and Supply Chain

• Hold a degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Have designed global template processes in a complex international organization

• Ideally come from medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry

• Have delivered global process transformation or ERP implementation

• Can challenge local practices constructively and create clarity on global standards

• Have Infor M3, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud or similar experience and are flexible to travel internationally

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

How to apply – please read carefully

We only review complete applications from serious candidates who have real, documented experience.
